source: 36 Binance Spot 14d 1h historical normalized arrays archived in four B181 files
forecast_algorithm: Fixed 2-state Markov sign transition + empirical mean positive/negative log-return deterministic jumps; absorbing first-hit on log(P/P0) in [ln(.97),ln(1.05)], 400-point grid, Bellman value iteration to 1e-11 or 6000 steps; 2 pseudocounts per sign outcome; last pre-t0 sign as initial state. IID-sign ablation identical jumps.
model_assumptions: Heuristic discrete jump approximation, no horizon, no rebasing; forecasts are label-exposed retrospective reconstruction, not pre-event issued
